subject.title: fix(heartbeat): stop reporting success after tool failures

question: Should `observeToolTerminal` become the supported plugin-harness API for reporting tool execution and recovery facts?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and optional, but landing it establishes a durable cross-plugin contract for mutation identity, timeout evidence, and recovery semantics that automation should not approve implicitly.

options.title: Approve the narrow observer contract
options.body: Keep the callback optional and facts-only, document its ownership invariants, rebase, and land after refreshed focused proof.

options.title: Keep the contract internal
options.body: Replace the exported callback with a bundled-runtime-only facade before merge, accepting extra internal wiring to avoid public SDK commitment.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow observer contract
recommendation.body: Keep the callback optional and facts-only, document its ownership invariants, rebase, and land after refreshed focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server terminal and liveness ownership makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-harness contract decision.
